pbbs_patches: Clamp initial speculative round size to at least one (upstream nine-item batch otherwise stalls)
metadata.timing: Prepared graph to sorted MST edge IDs; excludes IO, parsing, input generation, and representation construction.
metadata.instrumentation: Prototype comparison counters enabled; reference algorithms uninstrumented.
metadata.weights: Integers in [-1000,1000], exact in both Rust i64 and PBBS float32; ties broken by original edge ID.
metadata.scope: Synthetic connected multigraphs; PBBS Filter-Kruskal is a research benchmark reference, not a claim of globally fastest MST.
